detail.body:
### Purpose

`vllm/models/minimax_m3/nvidia/model.py` leaves each layer's FFN output un-reduced. The next layer's `input_layernorm`, or the final norm, then completes that all-reduce through `fused_allreduce_gemma_rms_norm`. `amd/model.py` never got this wiring, so it fuses only the attention-site all-reduce. At TP > 1, every AMD layer pays a separate full-hidden all-reduce plus a separate norm for its FFN output.

This PR ports the NVIDIA wiring to the AMD model:

- `MiniMaxM3MoE` and `MiniMaxM3MLP` are built with `reduce_results=False`. `MiniMaxM3DecoderLayer.ffn_all_reduce_deferred` reports whether the FFN output was left un-reduced.
- `MiniMaxM3Model._configure_allreduce_fusion` sets `fuse_input_allreduce` on each layer that follows a deferring layer. The final norm absorbs the last layer's reduce.
- MTP blocks (`is_mtp_block=True`) and PP > 1 keep reducing. MTP adds the residual directly, and PP ships hidden states across stages.
- An EAGLE3 aux capture taken right after a deferring layer reduces a copy, so it never records a per-rank partial sum. The deferral chain itself is untouched.

Each FFN-site all-reduce now goes through the same fused helper as the attention site. On ROCm that means AITER's one-stage fused AR + RMSNorm at decode sizes, and FlyDSL QuickReduce's fused kernel at prefill sizes once #61021 and its follow-up land.

### Not a duplicate

Searched open PRs for "MiniMax-M3 all-reduce", "fuse_input_allreduce", and "ffn_all_reduce_deferred". The NVIDIA model already has this wiring; nothing open ports it to the AMD model.

### Test Plan

- Unit test, CPU only: `pytest tests/models/minimax_m3/test_xlayer_allreduce_fusion.py`. It drives the real `MiniMaxM3Model` wiring methods with stand-in layers and checks:
  - the dense-then-MoE chain;
  - which captures reduce;
  - every defer pattern × EAGLE3 capture set for 1–6 layers: each deferred all-reduce is completed exactly once, and no capture sees a partial.
- End to end on MI350X (gfx950), TP4, `amd/MiniMax-M3-MXFP4`. Serve flags: fp8 KV, chunked prefill 32768, AITER MoE, FP8 attention via `--quantization-config`. `vllm bench serve` random, 2 repeats. GSM8K 5-shot.

### Test Result

| | 8k/1k c32 tok/s | 60k/600 c64 tok/s | GSM8K (n=400) |
|---|---|---|---|
| main | 1997 | 489.4 | 0.8425 |
| this PR | 1993 (−0.2 %) | 488.9 (−0.1 %) | 0.8300 |
| this PR + FlyDSL QuickReduce fused prefill norm (#61021 + follow-up) | 2037 (+2.0 %) | 515.3 (+5.3 %) | 0.8275 |

On its own the change is perf-neutral and that is because at prefill sizes today the deferred all-reduce still runs unfused, just one layer later. It is the prerequisite for fusing both all-reduce sites per layer. FlyDSL QuickReduce plus the fused prefill norm without this PR gives +3.2 % at 60k c64, no better than FlyDSL QuickReduce alone (+3.3 %); with this PR, +5.3 %.

---

AI assistance [Opus 4,6] was used to prepare this change and the PR body draft

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""MiniMax-M3 (AMD) cross-layer FFN all-reduce deferral wiring.
+
+Every deferred all-reduce must be completed exactly once, by the next layer's
+input norm or the final norm, and an EAGLE3 capture must never record a
+per-rank partial sum. The wiring only reads a few layer attributes, so it is
+driven on CPU with stand-in layers.
+"""
+
+from itertools import product
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+
+from vllm.models.minimax_m3.amd.model import MiniMaxM3Model
+
+
+def _model(defers, aux=()):
+    layers = [
+        SimpleNamespace(ffn_all_reduce_deferred=d, fuse_input_allreduce=False)
+        for d in defers
+    ]
+    m = SimpleNamespace(
+        layers=layers,
+        start_layer=0,
+        end_layer=len(layers),
+        aux_hidden_state_layers=tuple(aux),
+        fuse_final_norm_allreduce=False,
+    )
+    MiniMaxM3Model._configure_allreduce_fusion(m)
+    return m
+
+
+def _simulate(m) -> tuple[bool, bool]:
+    """Walk one forward pass: (captures see reduced values, AR chain balanced)."""
+    pending = False
+    captures_ok = balance_ok = True
+    for idx, layer in enumerate(m.layers):
+        if layer.fuse_input_allreduce != pending:
+            balance_ok = False
+        pending = layer.ffn_all_reduce_deferred
+        cap = idx + 1
+        if cap in m.aux_hidden_state_layers and pending:
+            captures_ok &= MiniMaxM3Model._aux_needs_reduce(m, cap)
+    balance_ok &= pending == m.fuse_final_norm_allreduce
+    return captures_ok, balance_ok
+
+
+def test_dense_then_moe_chain():
+    m = _model([False] * 3 + [True] * 5)
+    fused = [layer.fuse_input_allreduce for layer in m.layers]
+    assert fused == [False] * 4 + [True] * 4
+    assert m.fuse_final_norm_allreduce
+
+
+def test_capture_reduces_only_after_a_deferring_layer():
+    m = _model([True, False, True, True])
+    assert MiniMaxM3Model._aux_needs_reduce(m, 1)
+    assert not MiniMaxM3Model._aux_needs_reduce(m, 2)
+    assert not MiniMaxM3Model._aux_needs_reduce(m, 0)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("n", range(1, 7))
+def test_every_defer_pattern_and_capture_set(n):
+    for defers in product([True, False], repeat=n):
+        for mask in range(1 << (n + 1)):
+            aux = tuple(i for i in range(n + 1) if mask >> i & 1)
+            assert _simulate(_model(defers, aux)) == (True, True), (defers, aux)

+    def _configure_allreduce_fusion(self) -> None:
+        """Fuse each deferred FFN all-reduce into the next layer's input norm,
+        or into the final norm after the last layer."""
+        layers = self.layers[self.start_layer : self.end_layer]
+        prev_defers = False
+        for idx, layer in enumerate(layers):
+            layer.fuse_input_allreduce = idx > 0 and prev_defers
+            prev_defers = layer.ffn_all_reduce_deferred
+        self.fuse_final_norm_allreduce = prev_defers
+
+    def _aux_needs_reduce(self, layer_idx: int) -> bool:
+        """An EAGLE3 capture right after a deferring layer would record a
+        per-rank partial sum, so the captured copy is reduced first."""
+        layers = self.layers[self.start_layer : self.end_layer]
+        return (
+            0 < layer_idx <= len(layers)
+            and layers[layer_idx - 1].ffn_all_reduce_deferred
+        )
+
+    def _maybe_add_hidden_state(
+        self,
+        aux_hidden_states: list[torch.Tensor],
+        layer_idx: int,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        residual: torch.Tensor | None,
+    ) -> list[torch.Tensor]:
+        if layer_idx in self.aux_hidden_state_layers and self._aux_needs_reduce(
+            layer_idx
+        ):
+            hidden_states = tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce(hidden_states)
+        return super()._maybe_add_hidden_state(
+            aux_hidden_states, layer_idx, hidden_states, residual
+        )
